stimuli.M: The goal is to minimize periodic wake-up P95 latency. The evidence includes a training summary table showing average latencies, where s50000_aall has the lowest average (132.9413 µs). More importantly, the retrieval runs provide direct P95 latency measurements for each config at a 3 ms period. For s50000_aall, the P95 latencies across 10 runs are consistently low: 126.36, 140.554, 94.81, 99.853, 93.049, 183.217, 109.519, 82.488, 87.387, 87.347 µs. The maximum among these is 183.217 µs, which is lower than the lowest P95 observed for any other config (e.g., s50000_aone has runs up to 571.84 µs, and s1000000 configs are all above 748 µs). Therefore, s50000_aall has the lowest worst-case P95 latency based on the measured retrieval runs, making it the best choice to minimize periodic wake-up P95 latency.
